title: Per-run budget override on tk cloud run
description: The only budget knob today is a deployment-wide var in wrangler.toml, so trying a smaller run means editing config and redeploying the Worker. Add --max-cost and --max-wall-clock flags to tk cloud run that ride the submit payload into the Run Workflow, bounded by the deployment ceiling (a flag may lower it, never raise it). Cheap-and-bounded then becomes a per-invocation choice.
